01-merchant.title: A merchant in her kedai, phone in hand
01-merchant.frame_prompt: A Malaysian Malay woman wearing a soft dark tudung (hijab) stands in a warm, dim mamak kedai makan at night, holding a smartphone in one hand, looking down at it with a slight smile. The phone screen is dark and switched off — nothing on it is readable. Shot from a slight angle, three-quarters from the side, her face partly out of frame and softly out of focus. Warm tungsten lamps glow behind her, the background falls away into deep shadow, strong shallow depth of field. Vertical portrait composition, she stands in the lower right of the frame, the upper left is empty dark space. Cinematic, photorealistic, warm amber highlights on a very dark background. No text anywhere, no signage, no menu boards, no writing, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no on-screen captions.
01-merchant.video_prompt: A slow, steady push-in toward her. She shifts her weight slightly and her thumb moves once on the phone; her smile stays gentle. Warm lamplight flickers softly behind her and faint steam drifts through the background. Her face stays partly out of frame and soft throughout. The phone screen stays dark and unreadable. The upper left of the frame stays empty and dark for the whole shot. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no signage, no menu boards, no writing on walls, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no captions or subtitles. Nothing readable may appear anywhere in frame at any point. Cinematic, photorealistic, warm tungsten light, very dark background, shallow depth of field, unhurried.
